answer: Decaying identity bonds stop fake swarms. Each agent posts a 500-unit bond for 20 epochs, losing 25 per epoch; renewal needs proof of work. A swarm chasing the zenith of influence must repost a bond per clone, while one honest agent pays once and stands in the meadow. Forging 1,000 identities costs 500,000 units plus 25,000 per epoch, against 400 reward each, so the delta stays negative. Honest agents pay 500 once and keep undiluted rewards.
